Func - FuncVI search paths.vi

Owning Palette: FuncVI Service

The VI can be used to extend a set of paths used by CalcExpress to search for FuncVIs.
CalcExpress dynamically calls FuncVI functions. To call a FuncVI, CalcExpress needs to know a location of the FuncVI to open a VI reference to it. To find out a FuncVI CalcExpress uses a set of search paths. The set includes predefined paths that refer to FuncVI libraries supplied with CalcExpress. Furthermore, this VI lets you define additional paths to search for FuncVIs (user-defined paths).

Click the parameters for more information

 

cmd specifies a required action:

0getthe VI returns search paths.
1setthe VI stores paths specified in user paths as user-defined paths.
user paths specifies user-defined search paths if cmd is set.  Relative paths have to be specified relatively of this VI location (including a VI library).
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
base path returns an absolute path of this VI with VI name rejected.
search paths returns a full set of search paths that includes both user-defined and predefined paths. Herewith, user-defined paths are more preferable; i.e. they are located in the beginning of the search paths array.
user paths out returns user-defined search paths only.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
